% Minmod slope limiter
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A6_minmod}
\sigma_{\text{minmod}}(a,b) = \begin{cases} 0, & \mathrm{sign}(a)\neq\mathrm{sign}(b),\\ \mathrm{sign}(a)\,\min(|a|,|b|), & \text{else}. \end{cases}
\end{equation}

% van Leer limiter (mean-value form)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A6_vanleer}
\sigma_{\text{vL}}(a,b) = \begin{cases} 0, & ab\le0,\\ \dfrac{2ab}{a+b}, & ab>0. \end{cases}
\end{equation}

% Monotonized-central (MC) limiter
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A6_mc}
\sigma_{\text{MC}}(a,b) = \mathrm{sign}(a)\,\min\!\left(2|a|,\;\tfrac{|a+b|}{2},\;2|b|\right)\ \text{when }ab>0,\ \text{else }0.
\end{equation}

% Sweby TVD region for all three limiters
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A6_sweby}
0 \leq \varphi(r) \leq \min(2,\,2r),\quad r\ge 0.
\end{equation}

% PLM reconstruction (unlimited)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A6_plm_order}
W^{L}_{i+1/2} = W_i + \tfrac{1}{2}\sigma_i,\quad \sigma_i = \tfrac{1}{2}(W_{i+1} - W_{i-1}),\quad W^{L}_{i+1/2} - W(x_{i+1/2}) = \mathcal{O}(h^{2}).
\end{equation}

% PPM (Colella-Woodward 1984) interface value
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A6_ppm}
W_{i+1/2} = \tfrac{7}{12}(W_i + W_{i+1}) - \tfrac{1}{12}(W_{i-1} + W_{i+2}),\quad W_{i+1/2} - W(x_{i+1/2}) = \mathcal{O}(h^{4}).
\end{equation}

% PPM parabola form with conservation
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A6_ppm_parabola}
W(\xi) = a_L + \xi[\Delta a + a_6(1-\xi)],\quad \Delta a = a_R - a_L,\quad a_6 = 6(a_0 - (a_L+a_R)/2),\quad \int_0^1 W\,d\xi = a_0.
\end{equation}

% Practical note (Stone+08 Appendix A)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A6_primitive_note}
\text{Reconstruct in \emph{primitive} variables }W=(\rho,\mathbf{v},\mathbf{B},p),\ \text{then optionally project onto characteristic variables via }\mathbf{L}\cdot\delta\mathbf{W}\text{ for each wave family.}
\end{equation}
